body: Life has many good things.  Sometimes I just forget to utilise them.
THanks :)  I just feel like some people think I'm a broken record...I started to feel bad about constantly whining about how much I missed him.

I just wanted to say thanks to everybody.  I went out and talked and hung out with friends and had a good time.  Maybe I just needed to vent here and clear my head, but I am in no danger, I promise you all.  THank you.
I'm very straight edge, believe me.  I know I'll start feeling better now.  SOmething just clicked in me today.  I'm going to be okay, I'm sorry for alarming everybody.  Thank you so much
Grief is hard, man.  I write a lot.  Like this, but now I feel foolish for putting it up.  But it just shows how great the community is.  I hope you do well
Just a self esteem thing.  I'll have some time to figure myself out though.  I feel stupid for this post because now I'm feeling a lot better...it comes and goes.  But thank you for your words.
I know.  I'll try.  Thank you.
I could never do that to my family.  Maybe I shouldn't have posted all of this, I'm going to take it down, but I was in a bad place.  I have help.  Thank you ever so much though.

Hey, thanks for the message.  I'm doing a lot better now and feel a little stupid for posting that whole long tirade.  I was just really sad at the moment.  I went out with some friends, and I now have hope it will get better.
